decisions: Per-language adapters replace the shared multilingual adapter (B5-PROBE-2026-001/-002 evidence; interference structural).
french/swahili/lingala serve on the BASE model — they meet their owner-approved bars untrained.

yemba/ewe/pulaar move to the DATA-FIRST track: no further training on current corpora (single-word/domain-mismatched data cannot reach conversational bars); their path is the 47-language transfer measurement + Tier B/C sourcing.
kinyarwanda decisive experiment approved (~$12-19): uncapped 300h, rank 32, best-checkpoint. wolof/fula training decisions follow its verdict.
Wave-2 budget ($346 reserved) remains held pending a recipe that passes a T6 gate once.

revision_2.superseded_by: ARCH-2026-001 (owner-decided): per-language models are research teachers only; production is one multilingual artifact; a bounded preservation-aware universal pilot tests exactly the unexplored recipes.
revision_2.what_changed: HONEST SCOPE (Codex review #5, verified): the phrase 'interference structural' overclaimed. Evidence covers ONLY the explored envelope: q/v LoRA at ranks 16/32, lr 1e-3..1e-4, one 9-language temperature-0.5 mixture. Broader multilingual recipes (preservation-aware full FT, distillation, wider adapter placement, internal MoE) were deprioritized on cost-benefit, NOT disproven.
